rule: One creature_template row per family with up to four looks (display id, scale, weight). One look ignores weight; several looks roll by weight; a spawn row can pin a display id and skip the roll. Health = base by expansion times template ModHealth times rank health rate (level function). Damage = template DamageModifier with the rank damage rate folded in once at load (CheckCreatureTemplate, called once after load; the value is overwritten from the database first, so no compounding on reload). Easy and hard tiers are sibling links and may share one display id.
keep: one family template with a weighted look list
hard tier that reuses the easy tier's look (shared display id)
separate health and damage tier multipliers
spawn-level display pin that skips the roll
change: keep the rank damage rate as its own runtime multiplier; the donor folds it into DamageModifier at load (ObjectMgr.cpp 1216)
warn on zero-weight looks and refuse an all-zero list; the donor does not warn in the code read (Creature.cpp 130-140)
cap looks at two or three on a phone so the silhouette stays readable; the donor allows four
name every look, tier mark and number ourselves
look_test: One family silhouette at 375 wide in three looks (weights 2, 1, 1; scales 1.0, 1.0, 1.25) and one hard tier that reuses the first look with a glow and a 1.15 scale step. Dom checks: same family across looks, and the hard tier readable without size alone.
